When we analyzed the data, we were in total shock. The scientists have started covering their backs, because nobody knows what you\'re capable of! Honestly, I\'m a bit terrified myself. Here\'s your certificate: you are a True Blue Gay. The gayest gay we\'ve ever encountered. Congratulations!

You tried to hide it, but your tendencies spoke for themselves. We aren\'t schoolboys here; we are credentialed scientists, so spotting a little twink like you is easy work. Here\'s your certificate — show it to your boyfriend while we get back to work. And don\'t you dare stare at our staff on your way out!

The scientists argued for a long time — some even threw punches — but the verdict is in. You are gay! Deep down you probably know it, even if you haven\'t accepted it yet. Don\'t worry, you\'re not alone. Though there are no other \"rear-wheelers\" in this lab, so get out. We value our backsides; we have families!

To come so far only to fumble on the very last question… I was actually ready to sign your \"straight\" papers. Good thing we scientists weren\'t born yesterday; we know how to spot your kind. Now beat it, you latent twink! Save your stories about liking girls for the circus. Everything is serious here!

Gotcha, you sneaky bastard! Thought you could outsmart the system and easy-mode your way out so we wouldn\'t find out who you really are? Too bad, you\'ve been caught red-handed, you little twink. We\'ll see you at the retake, though let\'s be honest: it won\'t help. Everything is clear as day already. Boys, carry him out!

Smart, beautiful, rich, and ready to do anything for me. And that\'s just the start—the list of red flags is ten pages long.

It\'s only gay if you make eye contact.

Final question: So, how did you like the test?
These \"scientists\" are clinically insane. I hated every second of it.
